purpose: Original loopable music for the game's defeat and victory end states.

tracks.title: The Legend of Trump — Fallen Standard
tracks.style: Original stylized low-poly presidential-adventure game defeat loop, 76 BPM in D minor. Sparse felt piano, muted low brass, distant military snare, detuned music-box fragments, and a soft analog pulse. Two-bar sinking introduction, eight-bar lament, then a restrained sixteen-bar loop returning clearly to beat one with a short controlled tail. Emotionally defeated but not horror; keep the low mids and center open for dialogue, UI, and failure effects. Instrumental only: no vocal lead, no chanting, no recognizable melodies, no trailer hits, no harsh distortion, no long reverb fade, no abrupt ending.
tracks.loopRequirement: The last two bars must resolve to the first downbeat with a controlled, seam-safe tail.
tracks.v6FollowUpEdit: Keep the arrangement unchanged; make the final two bars resolve cleanly to the first downbeat with a short tail for a seamless defeat-screen loop.

tracks.title: The Legend of Trump — Golden Signature
tracks.style: Original stylized low-poly presidential-adventure game victory loop, 108 BPM in G major. Bright pizzicato strings, warm ceremonial brass fanfare, light handclaps and toms, celesta, gentle snare, and glockenspiel. Two-bar logo stinger, then a confident sixteen-bar celebratory hook that returns cleanly to beat one. Playful, heroic, and ceremonial without being bombastic; keep space for victory UI and gameplay effects. Instrumental only: no vocal lead, no chanting, no recognizable melodies, no huge trailer hits, no harsh distortion, no long reverb fade, no abrupt ending.
tracks.loopRequirement: The last two bars must resolve to the first downbeat with a controlled, seam-safe tail.
tracks.v6FollowUpEdit: Keep the arrangement unchanged; make the final two bars resolve cleanly to the first downbeat with a short tail for a seamless victory-screen loop.
